definition.name: Create Doors And Windows From Table
definition.description: Places sized doors and windows into the nearest matching host wall from mm coordinate tables, loading optional library families.
definition.aiDescription: Places sized doors and windows into the nearest matching host wall from mm coordinate tables, loading optional library families.
examples: Load standard door families if available, create sized door/window types, and place Block C doors (97) and windows (25) in their host walls on Level 2.
